items.title: Novo outlays $2.6bn in Hengrui deal to bolster oral obesity pipeline
items.summary: Novo forges this deal as the company looks to extend the lead secured from its first-to-market advantage in the oral weight loss drug arena.

items.title: MSD bets $2.13bn on SciBrunch’s KRAS (ON) inhibitor
items.summary: MSD's bet on targeting RAS comes amid the industry buzz around the approval of Revolution's OS-doubling pancreatic cancer drug, Rasonque.

items.title: AstraZeneca to invest $2bn in Summit for ADC combination therapies
items.summary: AstraZeneca has agreed to invest $2bn in newly issued equity in Summit Therapeutics to develop combination therapies using the bispecific antibody ivonescimab and ADCs across multiple tumour types.

items.title: Tolerance Bio signs $560m worldwide TLB-33 deal with Tanabe Pharma
items.summary: Tolerance Bio has signed an agreement securing an exclusive licence from Tanabe Pharma for TLB-33 in a deal of up to around $560m.

items.title: Beyond OEB5: Is OEB6 really the next standard for high-potency pharma?
